# 331_R7UX.8 — token-level chat streaming, part 1: `chat.token` plumbing + ADR-137 (BL-99a)

## What

BL-99 part 1 (GD-UX-STREAM.R7's "tokens later"; RV-3): a `chat_turn` now emits token-level deltas
end-to-end — SDK `stream_event` → engine mapper `chat.token` → the existing harness event pipe →
`postEvents`/`eventWriter` → `run_events` → Redis wakeups → `/runs/:id/events` SSE. No second wake
path: token rows ride the same seq-monotonic append + 322_R6FIX.51 commit-time deferred wake as
every other event.

**ADR-137** (`docs/adr/ADR-137-token-level-chat-streaming.md`) precedes the code in this PR and
decides the load-bearing questions:

- **Event shape** — `chat.token {turnId, seq, text}`: `turnId` binds the delta to the turn (the id
  frozen into `inputs` at turn creation, the same key the completion record carries); `seq` is the
  per-turn token ordinal (the client's dedup/coalescing key); `text` is `boundedText`-capped
  (REQ-DATA-37) — over-long SDK deltas split into consecutive events.
- **Persist, replay live-only** — fanout-only is undeliverable under the current machinery
  (Postgres `run_events` is the sole source of SSE rows; Redis is wakeup-only), so tokens persist
  and the READ side carries the ephemerality: a new `ephemeral` catalogue flag +
  `readUserEventsAfter(ephemeral: "live-only")` drops ephemeral rows once the run is terminal on
  replay-class reads (SSE catch-up, `?poll=1`, BFF seeds) — **a late subscriber can never replay a
  finished turn's stale deltas** — while a mid-flight replay still returns them (UX.9 dedups by
  `seq`) and the live tail always includes them (a just-completed run's last deltas still deliver).
- **Visibility/density** — `verbose` ⇒ the requester-only density (REQ-DATA-38): a summary-capped
  viewer structurally never receives model text.
- **Privacy boundary** — only `content_block_delta`/`text_delta` maps; `thinking_delta` and
  `input_json_delta` are dropped — no partial chain-of-thought, no partial tool input, no
  protocol/eval text.
- **Opt-in** — `includePartialMessages` (a REAL vendored-SDK `Options` field, §12.2's deliberate
  `false`) is set ONLY for phases whose frozen inputs carry a valid `turnId` — one shared
  derivation (`chatTurnIdFor`) feeds both the SDK options and the `MapperContext.chatTurnId` gate,
  so the partial stream can never be enabled for a phase that can't bind tokens; a malformed
  `turnId` degrades to no-streaming rather than throwing mid-turn.
- **Renderer contract** (UX.9 codes against): append-by-`turnId`, dedup-by-`seq`, rAF coalescing,
  completion swaps to the canonical record; zero-token turns render exactly as today.

## Shape

- `packages/contracts/src/events.ts` — `chat.token` catalogue entry; `ephemeral?: boolean` on
  `EventDef`; `EPHEMERAL_EVENT_TYPES`.
- `packages/engine` — `sdk-types.ts` `SdkStreamDeltaEvent`; `mapper.ts` `MapperContext.chatTurnId`
  + `chatTurnIdFor(req)` + `handleStreamEvent` (split >280, per-phase `seq`, drop non-text deltas);
  `options.ts` `includePartialMessages` (set via `chatTurnIdFor`); all three engines pass
  `chatTurnId` (AgentSdkEngine, FakeEngine, ManagedAgentsEngine — fixtures/conformance map the new
  path for free).
- `apps/run-task/src/sdk-adapter.ts` — forwards `includePartialMessages` only when set (non-chat
  phases keep the pre-UX.8 options byte-for-byte).
- `packages/orchestrator/src/event-stream.ts` — `ReadEventsOptions.ephemeral`; `EventReadMode.tail`;
  `RunEventStreamer.pump` reads catch-up vs tail differently.
- `apps/api/src/sse-routes.ts` — catch-up/poll → `live-only`; tail → `include`.
- `apps/web/src/feed-labels.ts` — `feedTemplateCoverage` exempts ephemeral types (chat.token renders
  on the chat surface, never the feed; `formatFeedRow` stays fail-closed so the rows drop silently).

Ordering is structural: engine events commit only after `step.started`/`run.started`, so a token
can never outrun its turn's start events, and every token precedes the terminal events.

## Tests

- `events.test.ts` — catalogue flags; `{turnId, seq, text}` parse + the 280 bound + id/seq guards.
- `mapper.test.ts` — ordered `chat.token` mapping, >280 splits, thinking/input_json dropped, empty/
  malformed dropped, unbound phase drops, subagent attribution.
- `options.test.ts` / `sdk-adapter.test.ts` — the `inputs.turnId` opt-in gate + real-field
  forwarding (absent otherwise).
- `event-stream.test.ts` — live-only vs include reads; streamer mid-turn attach → live deltas,
  terminal attach → none, mid-flight reconnect → replayed for seq-dedup.
- `sse-routes.test.ts` — poll: requester sees live tokens mid-turn; zero tokens after terminal;
  summary viewer never sees token text.
- `apps/run-task/src/chat-token-stream.test.ts` — the composed leg: FakeEngine (real mapper) →
  `runAgentPhase` → `EventBufferClient` → real `postEvents` → PGlite `run_events` → SSE-reader
  streamer: N deltas → N ordered `chat.token` rows (monotonic stamped seq + 0..N−1 payload seq)
  visible to TWO concurrent subscribers before completion; non-chat phase emits nothing.
